sections.text_helper: Section 64.16 "I3C registers" in chapter 64 (Improved inter-integrated circuit (I3C)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3232.
sections.section_content:
The I3C registers must be accessed with a 32-bit word aligned address.
Note: I3C_RDR and I3C_TDR registers must be accessed with a single significant LSB data byte
for, respectively, reading RX-FIFO and writing TX-FIFO.
